# derivation type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivationType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind(s) of derivation relating source and product — cover, remix, sample, arrangement, etc. Non-functional: a single derivation may combine types (e.g. a sampled cover).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) -> [`gmeow:DerivationType`](../classes/gmeow-DerivationType.md)

Use [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) to [`gmeow:DerivationType`](../classes/gmeow-DerivationType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

[`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md), [`gmeow:DerivationType`](../classes/gmeow-DerivationType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use inside a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) to name the kind(s) of derivation — cover, remix, sample, arrangement, transcription, quotation; non-functional so a sampled cover can carry several.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the derivation kind as a relator subclass ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9) — it is a value vocabulary) and avoid leaving it unset; the relator requires at least one type.

### How to use

- Point the [`CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) at one or more [`gmeow:DerivationType`](../classes/gmeow-DerivationType.md) individuals; extend the vocabulary with new individuals rather than subclasses when a domain needs one.

### Examples

- ex:d1 [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md) [`gmeow:derivationTypeRemix`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeRemix.md), [`gmeow:derivationTypeSample`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeSample.md).
